title: Black Squid Shiraz Gin
description:
If you love Barossa Valley Shiraz, you'll just love this Shiraz Gin. Made from award-winning grapes grown on our own Klahn Estate vineyards, pressed in our winery and then distilled on the property.

A deep purple colour with palate weight and length, juniper adding brightness.
serve: Enjoy it neat, over ice, or with tonic.
